skill.displayName: Pet Adaptive Drying Temperature Recommendation | 宠物烘干温度自适应推荐

version.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.7 in SKILL.md.
- Removed skill-card.md from the repository.
- No changes to code or core functionality; documentation and metadata updates only.

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches pet media analysis, but it silently creates/reuses identities, stores tokens locally, and registers/logs in to a remote service with limited user control.

dimensions.detail: Runtime code reads environment identity values, checks a workspace data file, creates workspace data directories, uploads local files or forwards URLs, and sends requests to lifeemergence.com/open.lifeemergence.com services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No destructive install hook or automatic execution was found, but installation includes executable Python modules and dependencies that enable outbound API calls, file upload, workspace data access, and SQLite persistence at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs automatic triggering on pet media and history keywords, suppresses the open-id parameter, and tells the agent not to ask or show identity values; history lookup is documented but identity-bound access is under-scoped for users.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The common utility creates or reuses a default local user, initializes a shared SQLite database, stores token/openToken values, and silently calls a remote phoneLogin endpoint with register=1 and silent=1 when tokens are missing.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Pet drying analysis, remote media processing, report links, and cloud history are described, but the bundled common code also performs account provisioning, token handling, generic API access, and local user persistence beyond the narrow analysis task.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill carefully before installing. It sends pet images/videos or provided URLs to remote services, can query cloud report history, and may create/reuse a local identity while storing authentication tokens in a workspace SQLite database. Use it only if you are comfortable with that remote processing and identity persistence model.
llm.findings:
[LP3] unexpected: Accepted in part: shell-script execution is normal for a skill, but permission boundaries for media upload, identity use, and local persistence are not clearly scoped.
[SDI-1] expected: Downgraded in part: cloud history/report lookup is explicitly documented, but automatic listing and bundled generic analysis utilities broaden the surface beyond a one-off recommendation.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: silent default identity creation, remote login/registration, and token persistence are high-impact behaviors that are not sufficiently explained to users.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as a scope-quality concern: dependency CLI text remains generic video analysis, while the top-level skill is branded as pet drying temperature analysis.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted: broad default triggers and history keywords could process media or enumerate reports when the user intent is not narrowly confirmed.
[SQP-2] expected: Accepted in part: remote processing of local files and URLs is purpose-aligned and mentioned, but the exact upload/URL forwarding, identity binding, and credential use lack a clear consent checkpoint.
[AST7] unexpected: Downgraded: dynamic ORM filtering exists in a generic DAO, but I did not find a direct untrusted user-controlled path in the main pet-analysis workflow.
[E1] unexpected: Accepted: the code can transmit openId/mobile-style identifiers to a remote login/registration endpoint as part of silent account setup.
